name: cairn-memory
description: Local-first shared memory for AI coding agents — one ambient memory across Claude Code and Codex: session briefings, pitfall warnings before repeated mistakes, auto-learned lessons with per-agent provenance, and post-compaction recovery. MCP server + lifecycle hooks on SQLite, FTS5, and local vector embeddings.
author: VEDTECH Solutions <info@vedtechsolutions.com>

scripts.build:relay: cc -O2 -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -fstack-protector-strong -fPIE -pie -Wall -Wextra -Wformat -Werror=format-security -o dist/src/hooks/hook-relay src/hooks/hook-relay.c && cp src/hooks/hook-relay.sh dist/src/hooks/hook-relay.sh && chmod +x dist/src/hooks/hook-relay.sh
scripts.strip:publish: find dist/src -name '*.map' -delete && find dist/src -name '*.d.ts' -delete && rm -rf dist/src/benchmark
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run strip:publish
